title: LIVE VISIBILITY
source_name: NOAA/NCEP HRRR 3 km surface visibility analysis, hourly cycles
variable: VIS surface analysis (meteorological visibility, not astronomical seeing)
what: Near-surface meteorological visibility from the operational HRRR analysis: how far a human observer, mariner, or pilot can distinguish surroundings through haze, mist, precipitation, and smoke. Low values flag navigation and shoreline hazards; high values mark crystal-clear Great Lakes air.
field: Visibility science (atmospheric optics and observing practice) quantifies horizontal contrast loss from scattering and absorption by hydrometeors and aerosols. It underpins aviation flight rules, marine navigation advisories, and air-quality perception, and is reported operationally in statute miles across the United States.
